title: "VoxelSize"

<!-- DO NOT EDIT! This file was auto-generated by crates/build/dl_types_builder/src/codegen/docs/website.rs -->

The scene-unit dimensions of one voxel in a sparse 3D voxel grid.

Each component is the size of a voxel along the corresponding local grid axis.
All components must be finite and positive.

## Dalaran datatype
[`Vec3D`](../datatypes/vec3d.md)


## Arrow datatype
```
FixedSizeList(3 x non-null Float32)
```
